topics.name: Medical image synthesis and multimodal diagnosis
topics.summary: Medical imaging papers combine foundation-model features, multimodal fusion, and weak supervision on retinal, ultrasound, and other clinical scans, with transferability and diagnostic utility as key tests.

topics.name: Planning, scheduling, and program synthesis
topics.summary: Planning studies use execution feedback, constraint solvers, reinforcement learning, and search to improve text-to-SQL, scheduling, code, and embodied decision making.

topics.name: Graph representation and relational learning
topics.summary: Graph-learning work learns transferable structure from unlabeled relational data through masked prediction, contrastive objectives, and topology-aware encoders evaluated on heterogeneous networks.

topics.name: Benchmarking and evaluation methodology
topics.summary: Evaluation studies build reproducible tests for load monitoring, model behavior, and system quality, showing that metrics and sampling protocols can change apparent conclusions.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and communication
topics.summary: Multi-agent papers study private memory, communication, and coordination under adversarial or partial information, combining learned policies with explicit protocols and recovery mechanisms.

topics.name: Uncertainty calibration and reliable prediction
topics.summary: Uncertainty work calibrates confidence or verifies model claims with Bayesian, conformal, and semantic checks, exposing gaps between fluent outputs and dependable decisions.

topics.name: Failure analysis for AI systems
topics.summary: Failure-analysis studies reproduce serving, planning, and deployment breakdowns, then trace them to workload coverage, feedback loops, or hidden coupling between system components.

topics.name: Tactile sensing and robotic manipulation
topics.summary: Robotic manipulation papers fuse tactile, visual, and proprioceptive signals to predict contact-rich futures and execute dexterous actions under sparse or delayed feedback.

topics.name: Quantized and low-precision inference
topics.summary: Low-precision methods compress weights, activations, or representations with quantization-aware optimization, measuring accuracy, memory use, and throughput across language and vision models.

topics.name: Aerial robotics and aeroacoustic perception
topics.summary: Aerial robotics studies exploit vehicle acoustics, event timing, and onboard sensing for perception and control, validating relative localization and navigation in outdoor flight.

topics.name: Visual anomaly detection and recognition
topics.summary: Vision studies detect anomalies, manipulated content, or rare objects with prompt adaptation and representation learning, testing generalization across organs, generators, and imaging conditions.

topics.name: Language-model alignment and instruction following
topics.summary: Alignment work studies instruction following, preference optimization, and refusal behavior using curated comparisons, reward signals, and adversarial prompts to separate helpfulness from unsafe compliance.

topics.name: Open-world image generation detection
topics.summary: Open-world detection methods adapt visual representations and data over time to recognize synthetic imagery, reporting cross-generator robustness under distribution shift.

topics.name: Distributed MoE transmission and networked inference
topics.summary: Distributed inference research manages expert traffic and cross-server communication in mixture-of-experts models, reducing transmission cost through routing, skipping, and topology-aware scheduling.

topics.name: Knowledge distillation and teacher-student learning
topics.summary: Teacher-student methods transfer semantic or physical knowledge between models, using anchors, feature matching, and distillation losses to retain accuracy with smaller learners.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning
topics.summary: Quantum-learning studies analyze trainable circuits, kernels, and generative models, comparing expressivity and optimization behavior with classical baselines on structured data.

topics.name: Monocular depth and geometric estimation
topics.summary: Geometric vision work estimates depth, pose, and scene structure from monocular or sparse observations, combining learned priors with calibration-aware constraints.

topics.name: Attention, caching, and efficient inference
topics.summary: Efficient inference papers coordinate attention, KV caches, and long-context memory, reporting lower latency or storage while tracking degradation in retrieval and generation quality.

topics.name: Image generation and scene editing
topics.summary: Image-generation studies add spatial or instance-level control to diffusion systems, using layouts, masks, and scene context to place or edit objects consistently.

topics.name: Research workflows and empirical methodology
topics.summary: Research-method papers examine reproducibility, system integration, and human evaluation, using audits, interaction logs, or controlled comparisons to identify hidden sources of variance.

topics.name: Multi-agent learning and embodied coordination
topics.summary: Multi-agent learning studies combine communication, planning, and cooperative policies for games and embodied tasks, measuring how coordination changes with partial observability and agent heterogeneity.

topics.name: Emotion recognition and affective modeling
topics.summary: Affective-computing papers infer emotion from facial, vocal, physiological, or behavioral signals, comparing lightweight temporal models and multimodal representations for robust recognition.

topics.name: Bayesian inference and probabilistic learning
topics.summary: Probabilistic-learning work uses Bayesian inference, latent variables, and uncertainty-aware objectives for structured prediction, with experiments emphasizing calibration and principled extrapolation.

topics.name: Whole-body human motion and pose modeling
topics.summary: Whole-body modeling papers learn human pose, gait, or motion across articulated joints, using temporal representations and generative priors to support analysis and synthesis.

topics.name: Model compression and efficient inference
topics.summary: Compression studies trade model size against accuracy through pruning, distillation, and low-rank structure, benchmarking deployment cost across recurrent and transformer architectures.

topics.name: LLM reasoning and process supervision
topics.summary: Reasoning research probes chain-of-thought reliability and latent computation, using verifiers, intervention, or process supervision to test whether visible traces support correct answers.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving machine learning
topics.summary: Privacy-preserving methods protect training signals and model outputs with secure aggregation, noise, or cryptographic encodings, quantifying the privacy-utility and communication trade-off.

topics.name: Reward modeling and reinforcement learning
topics.summary: Reward-learning papers shape behavior with preference signals, rubric feedback, or structured returns, evaluating how reward design affects exploration, alignment, and long-horizon control.

topics.name: Visual question answering and multimodal querying
topics.summary: Question-answering work grounds visual or multimodal responses in regions, retrieved evidence, and structured queries, improving factuality on image-centric tasks.

topics.name: Evolutionary optimization and automated design
topics.summary: Evolutionary optimization papers search over programs, architectures, or policies with mutation, population selection, and learned surrogates, comparing solution quality and search efficiency.

topics.name: Gait analysis and locomotion modeling
topics.summary: Gait studies model locomotion from wearable or video signals, using temporal dynamics and subject-aware features to distinguish patterns across people and conditions.

topics.name: Documentation and software engineering agents
topics.summary: Software documentation work uses language models and structured repository context to generate, retrieve, or verify developer-facing artifacts, with correctness and maintainability as outcomes.

topics.name: Traffic forecasting and transportation systems
topics.summary: Transportation studies forecast demand or state and optimize traffic decisions, combining graph or sequence models with real-time constraints for networked mobility.

topics.name: Facility placement and resource allocation
topics.summary: Placement problems optimize locations, assignments, or layouts under geometric and resource constraints, comparing exact, heuristic, and learned search strategies.

topics.name: Continual learning and adaptation
topics.summary: Continual-learning studies preserve prior capabilities while adapting to new tasks, using replay, parameter isolation, or self-supervision to control drift and forgetting.

topics.name: Forecasting and predictive modeling
topics.summary: Forecasting papers predict energy, loads, or operational outcomes from short and noisy histories, comparing statistical baselines with neural models and uncertainty estimates.

topics.name: Spanish language modeling and cultural NLP
topics.summary: Spanish-language research adapts language models and speech or text pipelines to regional variation, examining data scarcity, morphology, and culturally specific evaluation.

topics.name: Sparse model execution and efficient inference
topics.summary: Model-efficiency work combines pruning, sparse execution, and adaptive computation to lower inference cost while retaining task-relevant features in large networks.

topics.name: Reservoir computing and recurrent dynamics
topics.summary: Reservoir-computing studies analyze recurrent dynamics and memory capacity, using fixed or sparsely trained reservoirs for nonlinear temporal prediction and stability tests.

topics.name: Video understanding and temporal modeling
topics.summary: Video methods model temporal events, motion, or cross-modal correspondences, using long-context representations and learned alignment for recognition and generation.

topics.name: SPAD sensing and photon-efficient imaging
topics.summary: SPAD imaging work reconstructs depth or intensity from photon-counting measurements, pairing probabilistic sensing models with neural refinement under low-light conditions.

topics.name: On-device learning and embedded AI
topics.summary: Device-oriented learning brings training or inference to constrained hardware, combining personalization, energy-aware scheduling, and compact representations for embedded workloads.

topics.name: Dataset construction and annotation
topics.summary: Dataset studies build annotations and benchmarks for scientific, visual, and language tasks, documenting coverage, label quality, and the effect of protocol choices on reported progress.

topics.name: Speech recognition and synthesis
topics.summary: Speech systems learn recognition, synthesis, and expressive control from audio-text pairs, evaluating multilingual transfer, speaker characteristics, and perceptual quality.

topics.name: Image segmentation
topics.summary: Segmentation methods combine weak labels, foundation features, and spatial priors to delineate anatomy or objects, with cross-domain robustness as a recurring test.

topics.name: Semantic scene understanding
topics.summary: Semantic scene understanding links pixels to language or structured labels, using promptable representations and context aggregation to improve fine-grained recognition.

topics.name: Image restoration
topics.summary: Restoration methods recover images from blur, noise, or compression with learned priors and iterative refinement, measuring perceptual fidelity alongside pixel error.

topics.name: Program repair and structured input correction
topics.summary: Repair systems transform malformed code or structured inputs into valid outputs, using syntax-aware decoding, constrained generation, and execution-based verification.

topics.name: Reasoning traces and inference-time refinement
topics.summary: Inference-time reasoning methods use self-consistency, rollouts, and external checks to improve difficult answers, while measuring cost and the reliability of intermediate traces.

topics.name: Backdoor attacks and defenses
topics.summary: Backdoor research studies hidden triggers and defenses in trained models, combining attack construction with detection or fine-tuning audits across modalities.

topics.name: Pixel-level generative modeling
topics.summary: Pixel-level generation papers control local appearance and spatial structure with diffusion or flow-based models, evaluating edits, textures, and high-resolution synthesis.

topics.name: Lens and camera-aware vision
topics.summary: Camera-aware vision work models lens, optics, and calibration effects, using geometric constraints to improve reconstruction and robustness under changing capture conditions.

topics.name: Rollout optimization and policy learning
topics.summary: Rollout-based learning compares intervention, planning, and policy updates over simulated trajectories, focusing on credit assignment, recoverability, and efficient exploration.

topics.name: Feature selection and representation diagnostics
topics.summary: Feature-selection studies diagnose spurious correlations and learn compact representations, using perturbation, attribution, and stability tests to connect features with generalization.

topics.name: Fairness and bias in machine learning
topics.summary: Fairness studies measure demographic or group-dependent performance and propose bias-aware objectives, showing how data composition and evaluation choice influence model equity.

topics.name: Load balancing for multimodal experts
topics.summary: Expert-load methods balance heterogeneous token streams in multimodal mixture-of-experts models, reducing routing imbalance caused by image resolution and prompt length.

topics.name: Model merging and vocabulary adaptation
topics.summary: Model-merging work combines task or language capabilities while preserving tokenizer compatibility, measuring interference, transfer, and parameter efficiency after adaptation.

topics.name: Instance-aware layout generation
topics.summary: Instance-aware generation separates neighboring objects in layout-conditioned synthesis, using explicit instance assignments to improve boundaries and controllability.

topics.name: Identifiability and closure in dynamical models
topics.summary: Dynamical-systems theory studies when latent state, randomness, or behavior can be identified from observations, clarifying limits of closure and predictive world models.
